remarks.zh: 计算柜子的板材尺寸。[Width], [Height], [Depth]为总尺寸，[BoardThick]为顶部、底部和侧面的板材厚度，[BackBoardThick]为背板厚度。(AI translated, please check)
remarks.en: Calculates board sizes for a cabinet. [Width], [Height], [Depth] is total Measurement, [BoardThick] is Top, Bottom and Side Board material thickness, [BackBoardThick] is Background Board material thickness.
remarks.ms: Mengira saiz papan untuk kabinet. [Width], [Height], [Depth] ialah ukuran keseluruhan, [BoardThick] ialah ketebalan bahan Papan Atas, Bawah dan Sisi, [BackBoardThick] ialah ketebalan Papan Belakang.(AI translated, please check)
remarks.id: Menghitung ukuran papan untuk lemari. [Width], [Height], [Depth] adalah pengukuran total, [BoardThick] adalah ketebalan bahan Papan Atas, Bawah, dan Samping, [BackBoardThick] adalah ketebalan Papan Latar.(AI translated, please check)
remarks.th: คำนวณขนาดแผ่นไม้สำหรับตู้ [Width], [Height], [Depth] คือขนาดรวม, [BoardThick] คือความหนาของแผ่นไม้ด้านบน ด้านล่าง และด้านข้าง, [BackBoardThick] คือความหนาของแผ่นไม้ด้านหลัง(AI translated, please check)
remarks.vi: Tính kích thước bảng cho tủ. [Width], [Height], [Depth] là kích thước tổng, [BoardThick] là độ dày vật liệu của bảng trên, dưới và bên, [BackBoardThick] là độ dày vật liệu bảng nền.(AI translated, please check)
remarks.tl: Kinakalkula ang mga sukat ng tabla para sa kabinet. [Width], [Height], [Depth] ay kabuuang Sukat, [BoardThick] ay ang kapal ng materyal ng Pang-itaas, Ibaba, at Gilid ng Tabla, [BackBoardThick] ay kapal ng materyal ng Tabla sa Likod.(AI translated, please check)
remarks.my: ကော်ဘီနက်အတွက်ဘုတ်အချိုးစီးချိန်တွက်ချက်မှု [Width], [Height], [Depth] ကအရွယ်အစားစုစုပေါင်းကိုဖော်ပြသည်။ [BoardThick] သည် စက်မှုလုပ်ငန်းအတွက် ဘုတ်အထုပ်နှင့် သုံးသော ဖည့်သားအထူတေ့၊ [BackBoardThick] သည် နောက်ဘုတ်အထူဖြစ်သည်။(AI translated, please check)
remarks.km: គណនាទំហំប្លង់សម្រាប់ទូ。[Width], [Height], [Depth] ជាទំហំសរុប, [BoardThick] គឺជាកម្រាស់សំឡីបញ្ជា, កម្រាស់សំណុំខាងលើ, ផ្នែកខាងក្រោម និងផ្នែកចំហៀង។ [BackBoardThick] គឺជាកម្រាស់ប្លង់ផ្នែកខាងក្រោយ。(AI translated, please check)
remarks.lo: ຄິດໄລ່ຂະຫນາດຂອງຕູ້ໄດ້.[Width], [Height], [Depth] ແມ່ນທີ່ຂະຫນາດລວມ, [BoardThick] ແມ່ນຄວາມຫນາວັດສະດຸ [BoardThick], ແຜ່ໃນປ່າດ, [BackBoardThick] ແມ່ນຄວາມຫນາຂອງສ່ວນຫລັງ(AI translated, please check)
remarks.ja: キャビネットの板のサイズを計算します。[Width]、[Height]、[Depth]は全体の寸法、[BoardThick]は上部、下部、および側面板の厚さ、[BackBoardThick]は背板の厚さです。(AI translated, please check)
remarks.ko: 캐비닛의 보드 크기를 계산합니다. [Width], [Height], [Depth]는 총 측정치, [BoardThick]는 상단, 하단 및 측면 보드 재질의 두께, [BackBoardThick]는 배경 보드 재질의 두께입니다.(AI translated, please check)
remarks.es: Calcula los tamaños de las tablas para un gabinete. [Width], [Height], [Depth] es la medida total, [BoardThick] es el grosor del material de las tablas superior, inferior y lateral, [BackBoardThick] es el grosor del material del fondo.(AI translated, please check)
remarks.fr: Calcule les dimensions des panneaux pour une armoire. [Width], [Height], [Depth] correspond à la mesure totale, [BoardThick] est l'épaisseur du matériau des panneaux supérieur, inférieur et latéraux, [BackBoardThick] est l'épaisseur du matériau du panneau arrière.(AI translated, please check)
remarks.de: Berechnet die Plattengrößen für einen Schrank. [Width], [Height], [Depth] sind die Gesamtabmessungen, [BoardThick] ist die Materialstärke der oberen, unteren und seitlichen Platten, [BackBoardThick] ist die Materialstärke der Rückwand.(AI translated, please check)
remarks.hi: कैबिनेट के लिए बोर्ड के आकार की गणना करता है। [Width], [Height], [Depth] कुल माप है, [BoardThick] शीर्ष, निचले और साइड बोर्ड सामग्री की मोटाई है, [BackBoardThick] पृष्ठभूमि बोर्ड सामग्री की मोटाई है।(AI translated, please check)
remarks.ru: Рассчитывает размеры досок для шкафа. [Width], [Height], [Depth] — это общие размеры, [BoardThick] — это толщина материала верхней, нижней и боковых досок, [BackBoardThick] — толщина материала задней доски.(AI translated, please check)
